授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 社会科学分野を例に，国際雑誌・国際会議の英論文の一般的な論文構成を演習を通じて理解することを目的とする．序論の節（例えば，関連研究のレビューや仮説の定式化など），方法論の節（実験方法，刺激，装置，手法，データ解析などの小節を添えて），結果の節（図，統計データ等を含む），考察／結論の節などを実際に書いて英論文構成と執筆に慣れる．なお，授業は英語で行う．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
The purpose of the course is to make students familiar with the general structure of English scientific manuscripts published in international (conference) journals in the fields of the social sciences.
We will practice writing the introduction (including, for example, descriptions of past research and hypothesis formation), a method section (with subsections on participants, stimuli, equipment, procedure, data analyses, etc.), a results section (including figures, graphs, statistics), and a discussion/conclusion section.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: scientific English writing, thesis writing, conference proceedings, journal manuscript writing
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Any post-graduate student can join and there are no special requirements with regard to your English ability.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
The final grade will be based on
1) presence, participation, and effort during class;
2) a midterm report
3) the final report - a scientific manuscript about the student's own (recent) research.
NOTE!
Plagiarism of any kind is treated seriously - the student should participate by submitting his/her original writing.  No Internet materials should be copied and pasted (or imported and translated) except in explicit quotations with reference.
If plagiarized materials are detected the student will be reported to his/her supervisor and will fail the class by default.
